{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 原生鸿蒙开发助手：hdc 设备闭环调试 + 设备面板（官方 client 插件形态）+ 离线官方知识层（Tier-1 随包）+ DevEco CLI 构建/签名/模拟器控制 / DSH-native HarmonyOS dev assistant: hdc device loop, live device panel, offline official knowledge, DevEco CLI build/sign/emulator","id":"gh:1333258432","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-hdc-bridge","slug":"1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge","topics":["arkts","deepseek-harness","deveco","devtools","dsh","dsh-plugin","harmonyos","hdc","openharmony"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 原生鸿蒙开发助手：hdc 设备闭环调试 + 设备面板（官方 client 插件形态）+ 离线官方知识层（Tier-1 随包）+ DevEco CLI 构建/签名/模拟器控制 / DSH-nat"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ive HarmonyOS dev assistant: hdc device loop, live device panel, offline official knowledge, DevEco "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"CLI build/sign/emulator"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-hdc-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> DSH 原生鸿蒙开发助手：`hdc` 设备闭环调试（看设备 → 截图 → 看图 → 改码 → 装包 → 验证）＋ 官方优先版本化知识层（离线 Tier-1 随包 + SDK 机读 + 官方文档检索"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"）＋ 可选官方 DevEco CLI 构建/签名通道。
> A DSH-native HarmonyOS dev assistant: the hdc device loop (inspect → s"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"creenshot → view → fix → install → verify), an official-first version-classified knowledge layer (of"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"fline Tier-1 bundled + SDK-accurate reads + official docs search), and an optional official DevEco C"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"LI build/sign backend."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 定位"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"hdc_mcp 等 MCP 服务器已覆盖 hdc 能力层。本插件不重写 hdc 协议，直接复用本机 hdc 二进制（3.x），价值在 DSH 原生层："},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 会话内工具卡片与 `read_image` 原生闭环
